en: Hm? This is an unusual group of people.

Tenko's a student council member, so I get
why she's here...

...but Shuichi, Maki, are you guys even
allowed to be here? It's already nighttime.
Ah!

I...I was just...keeping watch for anyone
out during nighttime hours...

...and then I caught these two roaming
around!

Yep! I'm just doing my job as a student council
member! Since I'm on the student council!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko...if you act that enthusiastic,
you come across as suspicious.
Kokichi! Go back to your room and sleep!
Ohh, I see you take your job very seriously.
But you shouldn't lie...
What...?

...Lie down on the job, that is!
Nee-heehee! Well, good night!
D-Do you think he could tell?

Who knows? It's hard to tell with him.
He's always spouting random nonsense.
Anyway, let's hurry. Angie's in her lab, right?

Typical degenerate male...
I asked you to do me a favor...

Not only did you ignore it, but now you're
trying to do something inexcusable!
Do you have a death wish, Shuichi!?

N-No! I'm sorry!
It was just a small mistake!
This is way worse than a simple mistake!
...Do we really have time for this?

Shuichi, stop pissing Tenko off.
Let's hurry up and go.
Yeah...

...Did you hear me?
I told you to stop pissing Tenko off.
<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor has to be custom made...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why go out of their way to make this?
Where is this budget coming from?
